purpose: Executable tier classification for #880/#882. scripts/release-gate.mjs uses this inventory to run core/public-readiness gates by default while keeping historical transition, approval, and package-publication checks as explicit opt-in tiers. Each entry additionally declares owner (owning surface), consumer (who runs it: pr-gate/transition-audit/operator-approval/release-publication, consistent with tier), and retirementCondition (explicit trigger for the retirement disposition) for #1503 script-surface ownership.
